# ABOH LEGAL

> At ABOH LEGAL, we offer versatile legal solutions tailored to the needs of Albertans. Our practice spans multiple areas of law. Whether in the Court of King's Bench or the Alberta Court of Justice, we provide dedicated advocacy in St. Paul and the surrounding areas, including Bonnyville, Cold Lake, Vermilion, Lloydminster, Fort Saskatchewan, Lac La Biche, and Edmonton.

## Key Facts

- Location: 4937 48 Avenue, St. Paul, AB T0A 3A4, Canada
- Phone: (825) 461-0107
- Email: info@abohlegal.ca
- Website: https://www.abohlegal.ca
- Founder: Prince Aboh, called to the Alberta Bar in 2024
- Legal Aid: Accepted
- Consultations: Available by phone, video, or in person
- Court locations: St. Paul, Vermilion, Lloydminster, Cold Lake, Wainwright, Bonnyville

## Practice Areas

- Family Law: Divorce, custody, child support, spousal support, protection orders, separation agreements, property division, guardianship
- Immigration Law: Permanent residence, family sponsorship, work permits, LMIA, study permits, citizenship, refugee claims
- Employment Law: Wrongful dismissal, employment contracts, severance, workplace disputes, human rights complaints
- Wills and Estates: Wills, powers of attorney, personal directives, estate planning
- Estate Litigation: Will challenges, dependant support claims, executor disputes, guardianship applications
- Business and Commercial Law: Incorporations, shareholder agreements, contracts, commercial leases
- Civil Litigation: Contract disputes, debt claims, negligence, injunctions
- Personal Injury: Motor vehicle collisions, slip and fall, insurance claims

## About Prince Aboh

Prince Aboh is a barrister and solicitor admitted to the Law Society of Alberta (2024) and the Nigerian Bar Association (2014). He holds an LL.B from the University of Maiduguri (2013) and an NCA Certificate of Qualification (2022). He is a member of the Canadian Bar Association, the Association of Family and Conciliation Courts, and The Advocates' Society.
